'''Uhrar''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], located on the continent of [[Alanciar]]. [[Wardmaster]] [[Quarra Thayn]] served as the chief military advisor of the city, where she lived with her husband, [[Brue Thayn|Brue]], and their three children.<ref name="pandemonium" />

*''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''
